label: Qwen Image 2.1 Multi-Ref Edit
description: Qwen Image 2.1 editing with up to 4 images: images[0] is the edit target (output follows its size), images[1..3] are references. Refer to them with @image_1..@image_4 (type @ in the prompt to pick one; they reach the model as <image1>..<image4>), e.g. 'put the jacket from @image_2 on the person in @image_1'. Resolution / aspect ratio / batch size do not apply.

image.error: Multi-ref edit needs an edit target — add a reference image with ＋ on the card, or wire one in; image 1 is the one that gets edited.

prompt.error: Describe the edit and name the images — e.g. 'put the shirt from <image2> on the character in <image1>, keep pose and background'.
